name: todo-skills
description: A lean, file-native backlog for coding agents: a task tree in TODO.md, a branch per task, tests plus regression before anything merges, and an append-only CHANGELOG.md.

interface.longDescription:
Todo Skills gives Codex a lean backlog that lives in your repository: a task tree in TODO.md, one Git branch per task, a failing test and the regression suite before anything merges, and an append-only CHANGELOG.md. Nine skills cover setting up a project (todo-init), planning and adding work (todo-plan, todo-add), building the next task end to end (todo-continue), editing tasks (todo-update), status and an offline HTML report (todo-status, todo-report) and releases (todo-release). It is for developers who want an agent's work tracked in plain files and Git history rather than in an external service.

Limitations: the skills are instructions only. They work in a Git repository with a test command, run git and the project's own test, lint and build commands locally, and read and write files in the repository and its ../<repo>.todo/ worktrees. They never fetch, push, tag or publish, ship no MCP server, app or hook, and send nothing over the network. Review TODO.md like code: an agent runs the Done when commands it names.
defaultPrompt: Set up a TODO.md backlog for this repository
Add a task to the backlog for this bug
Continue with the next task in TODO.md
